Changelog

Source: NEWS.md

concert (development version)

  • Remotes no longer pins ComptoxR to a release tag, so installers such as pak accept any ComptoxR that meets the Imports floor (>= 4.0.3) instead of failing when a consumer’s lockfile records a different ComptoxR commit.

  • CAS cleaning rejects EC-formatted and explicitly EC/EINECS/ELINCS-labelled identifiers instead of rebuilding their digits into checksum-valid CAS numbers. Text extraction retains genuine CAS values alongside those other identifiers.
